sloka: पूजयन्ति महत्मनम् जह्नुम् पुरुष सत्तमम् ।गंगम् च अपि नयन्ति स्म दुहितृत्वे महात्मनः ॥१-४३-३६॥
transliteration: pūjayanti mahatmanam jahnum puruṣa sattamam ।gaṁgam ca api nayanti sma duhitṛtve mahātmanaḥ ॥1-43-36॥

translations.english: Devatas, rishis and gandharvas stood amazed (at this act). They worshipped the magnanimous Jahnu, noblest among men. The devatas entreated the illustrious Jahnu to treat Ganga as his daughter.
